summary: Basse-Terre Baillif Airport is a small regional airport located in the commune of Baillif on the southwestern coast of Basse-Terre island in Guadeloupe. It serves Basse-Terre, the administrative capital of the French overseas department, and provides convenient access to the island's volcanic southern region including the La Soufrière volcano and surrounding Guadeloupe National Park rainforest. The airport operates under French aviation regulations and primarily handles regional and inter-island traffic.
